title: 第457章 必须把曹立交出来第456章 赵奎带人冲丹峰
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
赵奎往前走。
他每走一步，蓝袍执事脚下的石板就裂一分。
“你问我什么意思？”
“我们执法堂弟子来丹峰查案，被你们五个长老围攻镇压。”
“现在你们还想封山压消息，说什么凶兽犯凶？”
“你们丹峰的脸，是不是炼丹炉炼出来的？这么厚？”
后面的执法堂弟子当场有人喊。
“赵师兄说得对！”
“把曹师兄交出来！”
“丹峰必须给个说法！”
外峰弟子也跟着喊。
“曹师兄替我们查案，你们凭什么打他？”
“丹峰长老犯事就能护着？”
“圣地还有没有规矩？”
声音一浪接一浪。
丹峰弟子全被喊懵了。
蓝袍执事咬牙开口。
“赵奎，你少胡说八道，丹峰今日确有凶兽犯凶，诸位长老出手镇压，与你执法堂何干？”
许柏当场乐了。“凶兽穿执法袍是吧？”
何林接上。“凶兽还姓曹，还叫曹立，是不是？”

丹峰弟子一个个脸色发红，却没人敢回嘴。
赵奎没有笑。
他抬手一压，身后声音慢慢低下去。
“我再问一遍。”
“曹立在哪？”
蓝袍执事强撑着。“我不知道。”
赵奎盯着他。“你不知道？那刘清河在哪？”
蓝袍执事立刻按刚才的话回。“刘长老闭关。”
“许承岳呢？”
“许长老也闭关。”
“另外三个八品长老呢？”
“都在闭关。”
许柏听完，忍不住拍了一下大腿。“好家伙，丹峰今天挺养生啊，全体闭关。”
他们越闭关，说明曹立现在越惨，说不定现在被抓起来上刑，殴打。
曹立到底怎么样了？赵奎的火一下顶上来。
“好。”
“刘清河闭关，许承岳闭关，另外几个也闭关。”
“那我现在要进丹峰搜人。”
蓝袍执事脸色变了。“你敢！”
赵奎抬脚又往前走了一步。

尊者九品的威压压得蓝袍执事膝盖弯了一下。
他硬是撑住，额头青筋都鼓了起来。
“赵奎，你别忘了，这里是丹峰！”
“不是你们执法堂撒野的地方！”
content_en:
Zhao Kui walked forward.
With every step he took, the stone slab beneath the blue-robed deacon's feet cracked.
"What do you mean by asking me?"
"We, the disciples of the Law Enforcement Hall, came to Danfeng to investigate the case, but were besieged and suppressed by five of your elders."
"Now you still want to seal off the mountain and suppress the news. What about the ferocious beasts?"
"Did your Danfeng's face come out of an alchemy furnace? Is it so thick?"
Someone from the Law Enforcement Hall disciples behind shouted on the spot.
"Senior Brother Zhao is right!"
"Hand over Senior Brother Cao!"
"Danfeng must give an explanation!"
The outer peak disciples also shouted.
"Senior Brother Cao is investigating the case for us, why do you beat him?"
"You can protect Elder Danfeng when he commits crimes?"
"Are there any rules in the Holy Land?"
Wave after wave of sound.
All Danfeng disciples were stunned.
The blue-robed deacon gritted his teeth and spoke.
"Zhao Kui, stop talking nonsense. There is indeed a ferocious beast in Danfeng today. The elders took action to suppress it. What does your law enforcement hall have to do with it?"
Xu Bai was happy on the spot. "The beast wears a law enforcement robe, right?"
He Lin took over. "The ferocious beast is also named Cao and Cao Li, right?"
All the Danfeng disciples turned red, but no one dared to reply.
Zhao Kui didn't smile.
He raised his hand and pressed down, and the voice behind him slowly dropped.
"I'll ask again."
"Where is Cao Li?"
The blue-robed deacon held on. "I don't know."
Zhao Kui stared at him. "You don't know? Where is Liu Qinghe?"
The blue-robed deacon immediately replied as he had just said. "Elder Liu is in retreat."
"Where's Xu Chengyue?"
"Elder Xu is also in retreat."
"Where are the other three eighth-grade elders?"
"They're all in retreat."
After hearing this, Xu Bai couldn't help but pat his thigh. "Good guy, Danfeng is very healthy today. Everyone is in retreat."
The more they retreat, the worse off Cao Li is now. He might be caught and tortured and beaten.
What happened to Cao Li? Zhao Kui's anger suddenly rose.
"Okay."
"Liu Qinghe is in retreat, Xu Chengyue is in retreat, and several others are also in retreat."
"Then I'm going to Dan Peak to search for people now."
The blue-robed deacon's expression changed. "How dare you!"
Zhao Kui raised his foot and took another step forward.
The pressure of the Ninth Grade Venerable made the blue-robed deacon bend his knees.
He held on so hard that the veins on his forehead bulged.
"Zhao Kui, don't forget, this is Danfeng!"
"This is not the place for your law enforcement officials to run wild!"
